name: cal_3x10_v3
notes: cal_3x10_v3 — 3 bands x 10 cells. First and last delay in each band set by the operator; the 8 interior delays are a GEOMETRIC ladder between them (constant ratio 1.3296 / 1.2762 / 1.1836 per band), snapped to the 8 ns PWM grid, chosen to give equal resolution per decade of sample delay across the whole span. NOT swept — no threshold crossing was measured for any cell. threshold_v is carried over from cal_3x10_v2 UNCHANGED and is now purely the cell ORDERING KEY used by pimd_shape / pimd_corpus_check (sort by -threshold_v); it is NOT the voltage at these delays and must not be mined as one. Front end carries the +97 mV bias (240k from 5V-REF to U3A pin 3, fitted 2026-08-10), so the whole transient is positive and no cell is excluded for railing — the cal_3x10_v2 skip spans are deliberately gone. Top-of-decay headroom is UNVERIFIED against the 5.000 V full scale. Pack-voltage window: full charge down to 21.5 V.
